why.source: 13 Pocket 3 clips (DJI 0197-0224, 17 Nov), one clip per section, each opens with a spoken slate ('Floyd, take A'); prepped and joined into media/floyd-ep-src/raw.mp4 (list.txt has the clip offsets). Every range starts after the slate, onsets from the audio energy (Whisper smears the first word after the slate)
why.hookA..E: one take each. C runs on past the sheet's line: '50 fights, 50 wins. He barely got hit clean. Here's the difference.'
why.intro: only take; spoken 'Episode 3' (45.8-46.85) cut out as in the Lomachenko episode, 0.3 s of his own pause kept before 'I'm Matteo'
why.body..takeaway: only takes, one clip each. Clip 0220 is 'The third one is the one that nobody copies', clip 0222 opens 'Number three, the pull counter'
why.end: only take; 2.8 s of room tone from the body clip's silence (60.2-63.0, same spot and mic) spliced after 'Monday to Friday' for the 5 day cards
